Description: Generates and emails daily traffic reports showing key metrics like sessions, users, and pageviews to stakeholders. The report includes comparison with previous periods and highlights significant changes [\[1\]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DLp9lwgrWGU#:~:text=use%20of%20machine%20learning,which%20will%20highlight%20anomalies).

Automatically creates and distributes reports showing user navigation patterns through the website, identifying common paths and drop-off points [\[2\]](https://databox.com/most-useful-google-analytics-reports#:~:text=paths%2C%20and%20goals%2C%20there,what%20pages%20and%20posts).
Tracks and alerts on changes in conversion rates across defined funnels, automatically notifying teams when conversion rates drop below specified thresholds.

Creates automated dashboards showing real-time campaign performance metrics, including ROI, conversion rates, and engagement metrics [\[3\]](https://rollout.com/integration-guides/google-analytics/api-essentials#:~:text=identification%2C%20and%20adherence%20to,data%20limitations%20and%20best).

Generates detailed reports on e-commerce performance, including product sales, average order value, and shopping cart abandonment rates [\[4\]](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1#:~:text=You%20can%20use%20the,with%20legacy%20Universal%20Analytics).
Automatically segments users based on behavior patterns and generates reports showing how different segments interact with the website.

Monitors real-time traffic patterns and sends alerts when unusual spikes or drops in traffic occur [\[5\]](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10089681?hl=en#:~:text=Explore%20Google%20Analytics%204%2C,from%20both%20websites%20and).

Automatically tracks and reports on specific user interactions like video views, file downloads, or form submissions [\[6\]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DLp9lwgrWGU#:~:text=uploading%20cost%20data%20to,tag%20manager%20Google%20tag).
